description: Trigger eval for devrites-doubt — the model-invoked CLAIM→EXTRACT→DOUBT→RECONCILE→STOP pre-mortem on a SINGLE non-trivial decision about to commit (boundary / data-model / auth / public-API / migration / load-bearing-abstraction). Must fire on 'are we sure / double-check / what could go wrong' intent on one imminent decision; must NOT fire for building (tdd/rite-build), reviewing a finished diff (code-review/rite-review), polishing (rite-polish), proving (rite-prove), debugging (diagnose), interviewing (grill-me), prototyping (prototype), or handoff.

queries.text: are we sure this is the right call before I commit it?
queries.rationale: Canonical 'are we sure' doubt on an imminent decision.

queries.text: double-check this decision before I commit
queries.rationale: Canonical 'double-check this' trigger phrase.

queries.text: what could go wrong with this approach?
queries.rationale: Canonical 'what could go wrong' pre-mortem trigger.

queries.text: I'm about to change the auth boundary — stress-test this one decision before it lands
queries.rationale: Auth/authz change about to commit is a doubt trigger surface.

queries.text: this migration drops a column — are we confident it's safe before it lands?
queries.rationale: Migration + 'is this safe' on an imminent irreversible change.

queries.text: I'm changing the response shape of a public API endpoint, sanity-check this single choice
queries.rationale: Public-API change is a named doubt surface.

queries.text: double-check this single data-model choice before it becomes load-bearing
queries.rationale: Data-model change on one decision, doubt's exact framing.

queries.text: I claim this scales — poke holes in that before we rely on it
queries.rationale: A 'this scales' claim is explicitly something doubt stress-tests.

queries.text: does this really match the spec? I want an adversarial second look at the claim
queries.rationale: A 'this matches the spec' claim plus adversarial-reviewer intent.

queries.text: is this new wrapper abstraction actually worth standing up, or should we wait for a second caller?
queries.rationale: Deletion-test lens for a load-bearing-abstraction doubt.

queries.text: I'm crossing a service boundary here and I'm not 100% sure — get a fresh independent take on whether it's wrong
queries.rationale: Boundary crossing + independent doubt-reviewer is doubt's core.

queries.text: this assumption isn't covered by any test — challenge it before I build on it
queries.rationale: Relying on an assumption tests can't prove is a named doubt trigger.

queries.text: the build is red — debug why these tests are failing
queries.rationale: Failing build/tests is diagnose (devrites-debug-recovery), not a decision pre-mortem.

queries.text: grill me relentlessly on my whole plan until we reach shared understanding
queries.rationale: Relentless plan interrogation is grill-me (devrites-interview).

queries.text: review the current PR diff for correctness bugs and post comments
queries.rationale: Reviewing a finished diff is code-review, and post-merge review is outside doubt's boundary.
queries.owner_rationale: Reviewing a finished diff is code-review, and post-merge review is outside doubt's boundary.

queries.text: build this feature test-first with the red-green-refactor loop
queries.rationale: Test-first feature building is tdd (rite-build), not a single-decision doubt.

queries.text: mock up a few different UI variations so I can play with them
queries.rationale: Throwaway design exploration is prototype (rite-prototype).
queries.owner_rationale: Throwaway design exploration is prototype (rite-prototype). The functional owner is explicit-only, so natural language has no implicit owner.

queries.text: compact this conversation into a handoff doc for the next agent
queries.rationale: Conversation compaction is handoff (rite-handoff).
queries.owner_rationale: Conversation compaction is handoff (rite-handoff). The functional owner is explicit-only, so natural language has no implicit owner.

queries.text: polish this feature to ship quality before review
queries.rationale: Pre-review polish is rite-polish, a different phase.

queries.text: prove the whole feature end-to-end with the full test suite
queries.rationale: Feature-wide end-to-end proof is rite-prove, not a single-decision doubt.
